architecture_decision: One read-only logical evidence graph federated over existing Pyat authorities; no new source database, controller, authoritative progress or Sorok actor state. Reuse shared source-backed reference methods but do not copy Sorok state.

identity.node_id: <jurisdiction>:<canonical family>:<original stable ID> (for code: CODE:<repository path>::<qualified symbol>); family collisions never merged
identity.revision: Same logical ID plus source_cut+blob_sha+assertion/evidence-event ID; no destructive overwrite
identity.many_to_many_membership: plan_memberships[] is non-exclusive; N4 can serve G/S/P and multiple F gates without cloning
identity.aliases: Only exact evidence-backed aliases; candidate identities flagged PROVISIONAL
identity.ambiguous_id: Hold UNKNOWN, do not join by matching display string

evidence_event_schema.immutability: Append new event, never update or erase historical RED/held events. Snapshot deterministic projection of selected immutable cut.
evidence_event_schema.promotion: Review requires verified reviewer appointment/principal distinct from author, exact subject SHA and assertion/scope; synthetic and test-only proofs cannot promote source-native claims.

relation_schema.inverse: Derived query over same edge identity; no second reversed authority edge

maturity_rollup.method: Per dimension return supported highest scope and independent blocked/unknown evidence; never compute percent nodes or matrix cells. AND gates require all relevant qualified source-scoped proofs; OR accepts documented alternatives; IF requires actual scope predicate and may remain undecidable.
maturity_rollup.current_vs_historical: Do not transfer a historical proof to live PRE-MAIN absent same object and owner CAS

validation_invariants.rule: Every factual node/edge links immutable path + 40-hex cut + supported scope and explicit limit; scoped blob existence checked when available.
Unique stable IDs within namespace; code symbol ID is not an original science or source owner ID.
Plan membership many-to-many, preserve both original and present definitions, changes do not overwrite history.
Use Astra requires[] as AND and conditional[] as IF; no `conditional` dependency becomes unconditional block.
All source-permission, original semantic, weight/design, scientific-method authority are separately issued and verified; do not infer from test/schema.
Engineered code, author tests, independent review, protected CAS and real first consumer are separate evidence axes.
Fixture-origin synthetic review and own asserted reviewer role cannot promote status; verify distinct independent reviewer, appointed scope and exact target.
Source withdrawal invalidates only actually dependent claims; restoring one does not erase another independent RED.
35 governed sources conserved; 1,890 documentary matrix cells are not authorized job denominator; no-drop also for HOLD/ABSTAIN.
Candidate P1 BatchManifest admission does not imply C11/I03/I05 executed; fail if represented as measured F1–F4.
RRIF terminal is finite historical accounting, not source or machine completion; retain FIABC/G01 REDs.
No output percentile, task done percentage, fabricated current worker process, no native actor/producer claim.
Cold deterministic replay and CAS/trust validation occur only in a later authorized S2 implementation; an S1 map never asserts pass.
Native ChatGPT surface optional; API/port only read-only and exact scoped. No ChatGPT UI considered terminal PROGRAMMA acceptance.
